original_pr160_claim: PR #160 claimed model SHL PIK balance declines from day 1

original_pr160_claim: PR #160 claimed model SHL principal repayment starts period 1 (2030) vs Excel period 24 (2042), gap of 23 periods
evidence: Model: first shp at P1 (1,773 kEUR). Excel: first shp at P24 (8.28 kEUR). Actual timing gap = 23 periods, not 4 as Claude review suggested. However model P14=0 and Excel P24=start, so timing gap may be partly explained by different PIK treatment.
recommended_action: Align SHL repayment trigger in runtime waterfall
notes: Actual gap = 23 periods (P1 vs P24). Principal repayment starts immediately in model. Principal timing is a confirmed driver.

original_pr160_claim: PR #160 identified investment base mismatch due to SHL IDC
evidence: Model investment base = -33,204 kEUR (shl_amount 29,135 + shl_idc 3,569 + share_capital 500). Excel investment base = -29,635 kEUR (shl_amount 29,135 + share_capital 500). Difference = exactly SHL IDC 3,569 kEUR.
expected_irr_impact: 1.17pp effect (S2-S1 = +1.17pp when using Excel investment base)
recommended_action: Align investment base in reporting harness to use Excel convention (exclude IDC)
notes: IDC in investment base explains part of gap. Effect = +1.17pp when using Excel inv_base.
